name: The Cube Club Adjustable Cast Iron Dumbbell Set, 10 kg, with Anti-Slip Rod
best_for: Home workouts with one adjustable pair of dumbbells instead of several fixed pairs.
pros: A set of two dumbbells, 10 kg in total, with plates you add or remove (the listing gives a range from 0.5 kg up)
Described as cast iron with a protective coating
The listing gives a 12-month warranty provided by the seller
The listing says the set can also stand in for a kettlebell or barbell in squats and lunges
cons: The listing gives the pair as 10 kg in total, so check the weight each hand will hold
Changing plates takes time compared with a fixed pair, and the plates are held by screws
SAT has not tested it: details are as the seller lists them
features: Two adjustable dumbbells, 10 kg in total (as listed)
Plates of 0.5 kg and 1.25 kg with screws (as listed)
value_for_money: We do not store prices. Check the current price and the weight or colour option you want on the Amazon page.
who_should_buy: Beginners and home users who want to change the load without buying several pairs.
avoid: Anyone who wants a heavy pair, since the set is 10 kg in total, or who wants to switch weights quickly between sets.
how_to_choose: Work out the weight per hand from the total, and check how the plates are fixed to the rod on the Amazon page.
final_recommendation: A 10 kg adjustable cast iron dumbbell set with a 12-month warranty; confirm the weight per hand and the plate fixing on the listing before ordering.
